name: Xingdeng Qiye
source:
An Illuminator living in the Starshard Beacon. She is the younger sister of Wishia Comet, the bassist and vice vocalist of the super-popular band, "Starkiss." She is responsible for logistics support, and purchasing props, and food when needed.

[spoiler]fter the fall of Starshard Beacon, Blessa Comet followed in the footsteps of Wishia, fighting alongside the original members of "Starkiss" to defend their homeland. Diligent and dedicated, she never takes any mission lightly.[/spoiler]
translation:
An Illuminator living in the Starshard Beacon. She is the younger sister of Wishia Comet, the bassist and vice vocalist of the super-popular band, "Starkiss." She is responsible for logistics support, and purchasing props, and food when needed.

[spoiler]fter the fall of Starshard Beacon, Blessa Comet followed in the footsteps of Wishia, fighting alongside the original members of "Starkiss" to defend their homeland. Diligent and dedicated, she never takes any mission lightly.[/spoiler]
